info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Terminal Configurations API
info.description: The Manage Terminal Configurations API allows businesses to update and modify the settings of specific payment terminals. By providing a terminal ID, users can change configurations such as payment options, security settings, and operational parameters. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions and retail businesses looking to adapt terminal functionalities in response to changing requirements or regulatory insights. Ideal clients for this service include developers and system integrators focused on enhancing terminal management capabilities.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of the terminal resource with ID RES-100045. Ensure you provide the correct fields to modify as per your requirements.

requestBody.description: Update the attributes of the terminal identified by RES-100045. This request allows for partial updates to the terminal's configuration, enabling clients to modify only the fields that require changes without needing to send the entire resource representation.
